text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: spike in container restarts for service=preFill-runtime (gpu-pool-7). 5 restarts in 3m, suspected OOM during prefill. Paging oncall.
jordan: Ack. I'm oncall, looking.
incidents-bot: Detect link: https://ops.redwood/investigations/3077774321 - auto-triage suggests high memory usage during prefill stage.
jordan: Quick snapshot from gpu-7-3:
```
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] runtime: Killed process 2145 (prefill-worker) total-vm: 3800000kB, anon-rss: 3540000kB
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] kubelet: Container "prefill" in pod "prefill-xyz" terminated with exit code 137
```
priya: Confirming. ML-runtime metrics show kvcache allocation spikes correlating with long-context prefill requests (~>600k tokens). Cache retention + batch prefetching is causing GPU mem to spike.
sam: Initial mitigation plan (short):
- route requests with context > 250k tokens to coldmodel fallback
- enable prefill trimming (stream-trim) for in-flight prefill > 128k
- aggressive kvcache eviction policy (LRU decay 0.6)
- throttle prefetch batch size from 8 -> 2
I'll run the k8s job for eviction now.
jordan: Applying k8s patch to increase oom_score_adj and enable pro-active eviction. Rolling restart affected pods (prefill-xyz-***). Patch applied: `kubectl patch ds prefill --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"PREFILL_TRIM_ENABLED","value":"true"}}]'`
matt: Customer-impact check: CS flagged 3 enterprise customers with reconnects / streaming dropouts around 21:10-21:15 UTC. No broad 5xx spike on API gateway, but degraded sessions for long-context requests. Sending interim update: "We observed a resource issue impacting long multi-chunk requests; mitigation in progress."
priya: After trimming + batch change we see restart rate drop: previously ~5 restarts / 3m, now 1 restart / 10m. Memory pressure reduced on gpu-7 nodes. Observed qps for long-context routed to coldmodel increased but latency within SLA for majority.
jordan: Log from recent attempt shows fewer OOMs:
```
[2026-03-17T21:18:07Z] runtime: prefill worker completed, mem peak 2.2GB, no cuda error
[2026-03-17T21:19:12Z] kubelet: Container "prefill" pod prefill-xyz restarted (reason: CrashLoopBackOff) - but retries decreasing
```
sam: Good. I'll keep eviction policy and throttles for next 30m, then consider widening patch if stable. Also creating follow-up ticket to add request-size-based routing in the router.
matt: Taking on-call handoff at 23:00 UTC. I'll watch restarts and notify infra if it climbs back. Also prepping a customer-facing post-mortem stub for CS.
jordan: Thanks all. Leaving the page open until handoff completes. :thumbsup:
matt: Got it — will escalate if restart rate > 3/min. :eyes:
customer-success: Thanks for the update — we'll surface to the affected accounts and share the interim mitigation note.
incidents-bot: NOTE: handoff scheduled to matt at 23:00 UTC. Incident channel remains open for updates."
